about: kmeans's application mutants (corpus wave HP1): edits of the example that its laws and cases judge, and edits that only TestKmeansAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (the seeded property against the plain reference and the hand Go control) sees.

mutants.name: kmeans-mean-rounds-down
mutants.rule: A mean rounds to the nearest integer, half up; rounding down can leave a centroid farther from its points than the old one.

mutants.name: kmeans-last-of-equals-wins
mutants.rule: Of equally near centroids, a point goes to the first.

mutants.name: kmeans-merge-drops-inertia
mutants.rule: The inertia of points together is the sum of their parts' inertias.

mutants.name: kmeans-seed-draw-off-by-one
mutants.rule: The draw u is below the total weight, and the point picked is the first whose running weight passes u: a point of weight 0 is never picked.

mutants.name: kmeans-one-round-too-many
mutants.rule: A run stops after at most ROUNDS rounds.

mutants.name: kmeans-empty-cluster-resets
mutants.rule: A centroid with no point stays where it is.

mutants.name: kmeans-split-drops-last-chunk
mutants.rule: The chunks cover every point once.
